meta.source: Point analysis of U.S. Census Bureau American Housing Survey data
meta.weight: WEIGHT (household final weight, household.csv) joined to project.csv on CONTROL; project records carry no weight of their own. Not a topical-module item, so SP1WEIGHT/SP2WEIGHT do not apply. MOEs use REPWEIGHT1-160 (Fay, 4/160).
meta.universe: Owner-occupied units (INTSTATUS=1, TENURE=1); every project record is in this universe.
meta.jobFilter: JOBDIY=2 ('did someone in your household do most of the work?' = No) for 'pro'; JOBDIY in (1,2) for 'all'. JOBCOST > 0 (excludes 0 = free job and -9 = not reported). Includes imputed costs (JJOBCOST=2, 15% of records) and incomplete jobs (JOBCOMP=2, 6%), matching Census Table C-16-OO.
meta.percentileMethod: Weighted percentiles, SAS PROC UNIVARIATE weighted definition; rounded to nearest $100.
meta.costYears: Jobs done in the two years before the 2023 interview: primary year 2021, 2022 or 2023 (JOBCOMPYR for completed jobs, JOBWORKYR for incomplete). Nominal dollars, not inflation-adjusted. Cost = respondent-reported cost of the entire job, including insurance-covered amounts, excluding own time.
meta.topCoding: JOBCOST is topcoded on the PUF: values at/above a topcode are replaced by the mean of those values (at least 3 cases), computed separately for each of the 15 identified metros and for the rest of the country; the highest value on file is $241,000 (range of topcoded values $82,000-$241,000). PUF costs are also rounded ($1,000-$49,999 to nearest $100; $50,000+ to nearest $1,000). No 999998 cap values occur. Top-15-metro records also carry disclosure noise.
meta.suppression: Cells with fewer than 50 unweighted jobs with JOBCOST > 0 keep n and set p25/p50/p75 to null.
meta.geography: No state identifier on the National PUF (STATE is internal-use only). Geography is DIVISION (9 Census divisions) and OMB13CBSA (15 largest metros; 99998 = other metro, 99999 = non-metro).
meta.stateRule: Metro = largest identified metro whose principal (first-named) state in the CBSA title is the state, used when it has >= 50 professional jobs for the card; otherwise the state's Census division.
meta.agingInPlace: AHS has no accessibility job type. HMRACCESS is a household-level yes/no ('did you do any of these improvements to make your home more accessible...') that cannot be tied to a specific job, so this card is null.
meta.solar: AHS has no solar job type; solarEnergy covers doors/windows (18) and insulation (20) only.
